title: Rip-off Rainbow Periastron for NPCs | by DuaKNo
features:
Rip-off Rainbow Pariastron OMEGA
By DuaKNo

7 Periastron styles, each with its own abilities. All damage is a % of the NPC's max health, and any hit on an NPC at 10% health or below kills it instantly.
Controls
Click = swing · Z Nova · X Angel's Past · V Lunge · F Second · G Third · B Style · C Destructive 
Styles (Z / F / G)
Noir Psi: Black Hole / Lights Out / Shadow Tendrils
Ivory: Heaven's Ascension / Judgement / Seraph Wings
Azure Alpha: Phantom Slash / Sword Prison / Chrono Rupture
Chartreuse Gamma: Green Forcefield / Green Laser / Gamma Cyclone
Amethyst Kappa: Amethyst Comet / Meteoroids / Crystal Prism
Crimson Mu: Crimson Pillars / Crescent Wave / Blood Moon
Grimgold Beta: Sonar / Echo Strike / Midas Shatter

When you execute, the script automatically puts simulationRadius to 1000, if yiu want to increase or decrease please get "Show Network ownership" from my profile
